## §4.6 three-tier decision

`TIER_3_CLOSE_SINGLE_RGB_QWEN35_4B_ROUTE`

- Tier 1 condition: primary recall >= 0.70 and primary FPR <= 0.10.
- Tier 2 condition: primary recall >= 0.70 and primary FPR in (0.10, 0.20].
- Tier 3 condition: primary recall < 0.70, which formally closes the single-RGB + qwen3.5:4b route under this R1 decision.
- If the observed values fall outside the three stated bands, continuation is denied pending a new user decision.
